description: Admin command-center dashboard with cross-module KPIs and click-through drill-down, plus global-search indexing of B2B entities and a final backward-compatibility + permissions hardening pass. This completes the admin visibility requirement (spec section 23/24), the search requirement (section 29), and verifies the whole module is additive, server-side-permissioned, and non-breaking.
steps: Extend the Admin dashboard (src/routes/_authenticated/dashboard.tsx + src/components/dashboard/*, admin-only sections) into the central command center from spec section 23. Add grouped KPI blocks: Business Overview (Total Sales Leads, Total B2B Prospects, Active CA Partners, Total Referrals, Total Bookings, Total Revenue); Sales Performance (team performance, conversion, revenue, pipeline — reuse existing sales widgets); B2B Performance (Prospects, Contact Rate, Meetings, Partners, Referrals, B2B Bookings, B2B Revenue, Top B2B Employees, Top CA Partners); Renewals (due/pending/completed, dormant); Documentation (pending/delayed/completed, TAT breaches); Attendance (present/absent/late/on-leave/missing-checkout/working-hours); Payroll (pending/processed/total cost/department-wise/LOP). Reuse existing dashboard-kpis.ts / dashboard-queries.ts and the HRMS/renewals/documentation query helpers; add b2b rollups via b2b-analytics. Keep this admin-only (do not expose to non-admins).

Make KPIs drill-down: clicking a KPI navigates to the underlying record list with the matching filter applied via route search params (spec examples: 'Active CA Partners' -> /b2b/partners filtered to active; 'B2B Bookings' -> bookings filtered to B2B-sourced; 'Overdue Follow-ups' -> /b2b/activities/followups filtered to overdue). Use TanStack Router search params / Link `search` so the destination list reads and applies the filter. Ensure each target list route accepts those params.

Global search: extend src/components/global-search.tsx (and its data sources) to index CA Firms, B2B Leads, Contacts, and Referrals in addition to existing entities, matching on firm name, contact name, phone, email, lead code/ID, referral id. Reuse the existing command-palette UI and the global-search-context. Keep result queries RLS-scoped (users only find what they may see; admin finds all).

Admin filters: ensure the admin can filter B2B lists by Department, Employee, Date, Status, Source, Location where those lists exist (spec section 24) — add any missing filter controls, reusing existing filter UI.

Backward-compatibility + permissions audit pass: (a) verify no existing migration/table/edge-function was modified; (b) verify existing Sales/Renewals/Documentation/Accounts/HRMS routes still build and are untouched in behaviour; (c) spot-check that every new B2B table has RLS enabled with admin-full + owner-scoped policies and that nothing grants a non-admin access to other users' salary or other departments' confidential data; (d) confirm the b2b role sees only assigned B2B records and own attendance/payroll per spec section 25. Record findings.

Final full gate: export node PATH; bun install --frozen-lockfile; npx tsc --noEmit; bun run test; bun run build; confirm routeTree.gen.ts committed. Prettier new files; no new eslint errors on touched files.
acceptance_criteria: Admin dashboard shows the Business Overview + Sales + B2B + Renewals + Documentation + Attendance + Payroll KPI groups in one place, admin-only.
Clicking a KPI drills down into the underlying filtered record list (verified for at least the three spec examples: Active CA Partners, B2B Bookings, Overdue Follow-ups).
Global search finds CA Firms, Contacts, B2B Leads, Referrals by name/phone/email/ID, RLS-scoped.

A documented backward-compatibility + permissions audit confirms: no existing migration/table/edge-function changed; every new B2B table has RLS with admin-full + owner-scoped policies; no non-admin can read other employees' salary or other departments' confidential data.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds.
verification: git diff --stat against the task base branch to confirm only additive files (new routes, new migrations, new lib modules) plus the intended edits to auth.tsx, app-shell.tsx, users.tsx, audit.ts, dashboard, global-search; no existing migration file modified.
grep the new migrations to confirm every CREATE TABLE is followed by ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and policies.
findings: Gate green: npx tsc --noEmit clean; bun run test = 243 passed / 18 files (229 after FEAT-008 + 14 new command-center.test.ts); bun run build ok (~12s). routeTree.gen.ts UNCHANGED and not regenerated — this phase added NO new route files, only optional search params to existing routes, so the tree was intentionally left as-is (confirmed via git status). DELIVERED FOUR PARTS: (1) ADMIN COMMAND CENTER — new pure/tested maths src/lib/command-center.ts (salesSummary, renewalSummary, docSummary, attendanceSummary, payrollSummary, bookingRevenueValue, isB2BSourcedBooking, pct) + src/lib/command-center.test.ts (14 tests asserting the bucket counts so a revert fails). Data via new src/lib/command-center-queries.ts (commandCenterQuery) — pulls leads/bookings (Sales + Business Overview), the full B2B analytics dataset (reuses buildFunnel/activityBreakdown/employeeLeaderboard/bookingValue from b2b-analytics.ts for the B2B rollups incl. Top B2B Employees + Top CA Partners), renewal rows off bookings (same renewal_status definitions as renewal-dashboard.tsx), documentation_tasks, today's HRMS attendance (mapped from first_login_at/last_logout_at/is_late/worked_minutes into the pure summary shape) + approved leave_requests, and current-month salary_slips (status final->processed). EVERY fetch is wrapped in safeSelect() so a not-yet-deployed table resolves to [] instead of throwing (mirrors dashboard-queries.ts telecmi guard). Heavy body in src/components/dashboard/admin-command-center.tsx (code-split — its own admin-command-center-*.js chunk; VERIFIED recharts is NOT in that chunk nor the dashboard route chunk nor the client entry; it uses KpiTile/CountUp + CSS only). Wired into src/routes/_authenticated/dashboard.tsx as an ADMIN-ONLY 'Command Center' view (added to availableViews only when isAdmin, lazy-loaded, and the render branch is additionally gated `dashView==='command' && isAdmin` so a non-admin can never reach it even by forcing state). The non-admin dashboard (Fresh Sales / Renewals / Documentation-only) is byte-unchanged in behaviour. Seven grouped KPI blocks exactly per spec section 23: Business Overview, Sales Performance, B2B Performance (+Top B2B Employees/Top CA Partners cards), Renewals, Documentation, Attendance (Today), Payroll (This Month) + Payroll-by-Department table. (2) KPI DRILL-DOWN via TanStack Router search params (KpiTile already supports to+search). Introduced validateSearch on three target routes (the repo already uses this pattern on bookings/clients/leads/follow-ups/sales-performance, contrary to the briefing's 'no validateSearch historically' note — confirmed via grep). THE THREE SPEC EXAMPLES VERIFIED: 'Active CA Partners' -> /b2b/partners?status=active (partners.tsx now validateSearch { status } and passes it as initialHealth to ActivePartnersPage, which pre-selects the health dropdown); 'B2B Bookings' -> /bookings?source=b2b (bookings.tsx validateSearch gained optional { source }, applied as a case-insensitive substring filter on booking_source in the filtered memo); 'Overdue Follow-ups' -> /b2b/activities/followups?bucket=overdue (followups.tsx validateSearch { bucket: overdue|today|upcoming } shows only the matching bucket). ALL params are OPTIONAL with sane defaults, so existing/direct navigation to those routes is unchanged. (3) GLOBAL SEARCH — src/components/global-search.tsx now also indexes CA Firms (firm_name/email/phone/alt_phone), B2B Leads (contact_person/email/phone/b2b_lead_code/alt_phone), Contacts (name/email/phone/alt_phone) and Referrals (referred_client_name/client_phone/referral_code), via b2bDb() server-side ILIKE .or() queries mirroring the existing leads/bookings pattern. RLS is the boundary (no manual assigned_to filter — a b2b user matches only their own rows, admin matches all), and each B2B query is wrapped with a .then(ok, ()=>({data:[]})) fallback so a missing table never breaks the palette. New result CommandGroups reuse the existing cmdk UI; firm/contact/b2b-lead hits deep-link to /b2b/firms/$id (or the list when no firm_id), referrals to /b2b/referrals. (4) BACKWARD-COMPAT + PERMISSIONS AUDIT — (a) NO existing migration/table/edge-function modified: git status on supabase/ is empty; this phase authored ZERO new migrations (frontend-only). (b) Existing Sales/Renewals/Documentation/Accounts/HRMS routes build + behave unchanged: only additive optional search params were added to bookings.tsx (default off) and the dashboard gained an admin-only extra view; tsc clean + build ok. (c) Every new B2B table has RLS: core migration 20260517000002 ENABLEs RLS on all 9 tables (b2b_import_batches, ca_firms, b2b_contacts, b2b_leads, b2b_activities, b2b_followups, partnerships, referrals, b2b_sources) with admin-full (public.is_admin) + owner/assigned-scoped policies (42 is_admin refs); 20260517000003 ENABLEs RLS on b2b_onboarding with the same admin+owner pattern. (d) Salary isolation: salary_slips + employee_salary carry ONLY an admin policy (is_admin) for ALL ops incl. SELECT (20260516000008), so no non-admin can read any salary row via REST; the command center's salary_slips read is additionally only ever mounted for admins. The b2b role continues to see only assigned B2B records + own attendance/payroll (unchanged from FEAT-002/FEAT-008; this phase adds no new grants). PER-FILE QUALITY: 4 new files prettier-clean (ran prettier --write) + eslint 0 errors. Touched existing files gained NO new eslint errors vs base (compared via git stash): partner-performance 0/0, followups 0/0, partners 0/0, bookings 9/9, dashboard 14/14, global-search 17/17 (my new interfaces + JSX groups were hand-written in prettier-compliant multi-line form so they match the file's base error count exactly; the 17 are all pre-existing condensed-style lines I never touched). GOTCHAS for any follow-up: (a) command-center-queries.ts intentionally never throws (safeSelect) so the admin dashboard degrades gracefully if a module table is absent — do not 'fix' it to surface errors. (b) The B2B Bookings drill-down relies on bookings.booking_source containing 'b2b'; if the owner tags B2B-sourced bookings with a different source string, widen the ?source= needle. (c) KpiTile.search is typed Record<string,string|undefined> and the Link casts search as never, so new drill-down params typecheck without the destination route needing to pre-exist its validateSearch — but each target route DOES validate the param so it is actually applied.
